# Alea Marketing Firm

> Email newsletters for independent shops, written and sent each month. A small newsletter studio based in Tucson, Arizona, USA.

Alea Marketing Firm writes and sends email newsletters for independent shops: a one-off setup, a monthly newsletter package and a list clean-up. Fixed monthly prices, cancel any month.

## Packages (USD)
- Newsletter setup (one-off): $350
- Monthly newsletter, 2 sends: $290/month
- Monthly newsletter, 4 sends: $490/month
- List clean-up (one-off): $180
- Extra seasonal send: $95
